rules: Do not call metered external provider APIs unless PAPERCLIPALYPSE_ALLOW_PAID_API=1 is set locally.
Do not add provider API keys to GitHub Actions secrets for normal operation.
Use local seed generation from data/seed-lists.json for routine episodes.
Use frontier models manually through their free/subscription chat surfaces only when that provider's terms allow it.

freeAutomationCandidates.condition: Use only within Google AI Studio/Gemini API free-tier quota and after accepting Google's data-use terms.

subscriptionOnlyCandidates.condition: Use through Codex/ChatGPT subscription workflows, not the metered OpenAI API.
Use manually through a free/subscription Claude chat surface if available.
Use manually through a free/subscription Grok surface if available.
Use manually through the Copilot chat surface; no API automation is configured.
